notes: Originally targeted dime-money-float-arithmetic-on-cents. That rule was measured to be structurally incapable of firing: its `patterns` block AND-combines a pattern-either with metavariable-regex constraints on $F and $C, and $C binds only in the parseFloat alternative, so the multiplication/division alternatives can never satisfy it. Isolated proof: the identical rule minus the $C constraint reports 1 finding on the same input; with it, 0. Recorded as a candidate finding — fixing the repository rule is outside P06's authorized scope.
dime-session-secret-fallback carries no metavariable constraints and is semantically sharp: a hardcoded APP_SESSION_SECRET fallback turns a missing secret into a forgeable session key.
